evidence: quarantined retrospective diagnostic; outcomes already inspected; not a new holdout
target: original-security endpoint price ratio; flat band [0.98,1.02]; never maximum holding-period drawdown
equalPopulation: Exact original adapter final-evaluation keys; no model-specific deletion or survivor intersection
directionDecision: Fixed argmax for four classifiers; conservativeDown changes only to down when ensemble pDown >= 0.65 and pDown > pUp; no heldout threshold optimization
priceBlendGrid: All convex price-ratio combinations of original/noChange/trend in 0.25 steps; no already explored PR25 joint-distribution retraining
priceBlendSelection: Date-equal MAPE on whole matured disjoint prior origin blocks, including boundary exclusion targetDate < origin. Joint selection adds down recall/precision/FPR, direction and tail guards. Infeasible joint selection falls back to original and records this.
macroRegime: Frozen SPY signalPrice series: strictly prior session close above/below trailing MA200; 63-session annualized log volatility >= 0.20. Four thresholds fixed before new candidate execution. No event narratives fitted to outcomes.
errorBins: original ex-post price APE <=10%, (10%,30%], >30%; same bins for every candidate; diagnostic only, never fit features
jointEvaluation: MAPE/return MAE/p90 price APE no worse than original; down recall +3pp; down precision >= down prevalence +5pp and no worse than available baseline precision; down false-positive rate no worse; up recall no worse; balanced accuracy no worse; accuracy beats original and always-up; at least 60% dates joint-noninferior; date-paired MAPE improvement CI lower bound >=0
uncertainty: Enumerate all date-block bootstrap resamples of four final dates; illustrative interval, never 1996 independent trials
nextProspectiveDesign: After PIT/identity/vintage/lifecycle blockers close: freeze all candidates and splits without retuning; collect >=8 disjoint matured 126-session date blocks, or retain overlapping monthly origins with horizon-aware blocked inference and no independent-date claim. Fixed threshold sensitivity requires a separate registered experiment. Costs/turnover require an independent whole-account test before any trading rule.
